name: Ice Manipulation
description: Ice Manipulation lets you surround yourself with various manifestations of ice and cold, assaulting and freezing nearby foes. Ice Manipulation powers are known to Slow opponents.

powers.name: Chilblain
powers.description: Immobilizes your target in an icy trap. Deals some damage over time and slightly Slows the target's attack and movement speed. Useful for keeping villains at bay. Damage: Moderate(DoT),  Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Frozen Fists
powers.description: Frozen Fists encrusts your hands in ice, giving them the ability to quickly inflict moderate damage on villains. The foe's attack and movement speed is Slowed, due to the chills caused by the cold blows. Damage: Moderate  Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Ice Sword
powers.description: You create a blade of solid ice that deals higher damage then Frozen Fists. Being hit by this Ice Sword will Slow a target's movement and attack speed, due to the intense chill. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Frigid Protection
powers.description: While active, you dramatically lower the temperature around yourself, Slowing the attack rate of all nearby foes, as well as their movement speed and damage.  The air around your body becomes so cold that attacks deflect off of it, granting you absorption, while your body becomes extremely energy efficient, granting you bonus Recovery.  Recharge: Very Fast
powers.shortHelp: Toggle: PBAoE, Foe -Recharge, -Speed, -DMG, Self +Absorb over Time, +Recovery

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description: Greatly boosts your attacks for a few seconds. Slightly increases chance to hit. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Ice Patch
powers.description: You emanate a patch of ice around you, which causes foes that step onto it to slip and fall down. This effect lasts until the ice melts. You must be near the ground to activate this power. Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Shiver
powers.description: You can blast forth a wide cone of chilling air that dramatically Slows the movement and attack rate of nearby foes. Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Freezing Touch
powers.description: This Freezing Touch will encase a single foe in a block of ice. This will deal minor damage as well as freezing them in their tracks, leaving them cold and helpless. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Frozen Aura
powers.description: Your mastery of cold enables you to dramatically lower the temperature immediately around you. Foes near you when you perform a Frozen Aura will be caught in a fragile casing of ice. Frozen foes will break free if attacked. Frozen Aura deals no significant damage. Recharge: Slow
